title: Validate LSB CDA arguments and target width during SCHC rule selection
description: Correctness codereview found descriptor validation in rust/lichen-schc/src/context.rs only applies mo_arg and target-value constraints to Mo::Msb. Cda::Lsb with another MO can select with missing or oversized mo_arg and an out-of-width target; generic decompression then subtracts mo_arg from length_bits and may underflow/panic. Validate mo_arg whenever either MO=MSB or CDA=LSB, require the argument according to LSB semantics, reject values above the field width, width-check targets consumed by LSB, and add cross-MO boundary tests at widths 1 and 128.
